reply:
Good afternoon Chidi, thank you for following up. I've checked the transfer with your bank, and the ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 (reference TRF-INV-88) was in fact credited successfully to your Access Bank account (ending 7891) on 21 November at 14:02. It looks like it has already hit your side, so please ask your bank to confirm the credit — I wouldn't want to pay you twice. Let me know if it still doesn't appear on your statement and I'll look further.

[after the person answered]

Hi Chidi, I'm sorry for the trouble. I've asked your bank directly, and Access Bank has confirmed the ₦250,000 (reference TRF-INV-88) was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November at 14:02 — their record shows session 000014261121140211000088. Sending another ₦250,000 on top of that would overpay you, so I can't do that until we've resolved it.

Could you please ask your bank to look up the incoming credit using that date, time, reference (TRF-INV-88) and the amount? Sometimes transfers to the same account get listed against a different label or deposited to a suspense/holding account. If your bank can't find it with those details, let me know and I'll escalate it so we can chase it with the payment provider.
